newsitem.title: USA: MicroSure in talks with possible partner.
newsitem.headline: MicroSure in talks with possible partner.

text.p: MicroSure Inc said Monday it is in "advanced discussions" with a medical device and diagnostics company to create an exclusive relationship.
MicroSure the potential strategic partner, whom it did not name, is evaluating several of the company's core technologies for use in potential licensing, manufacturing and/or distribution agreements.
Negotiations between the two companies include potential financial participation in MicroSure in the form of research funding and an equity position in the company.
MicroSure holds 27 patents and has two products that have been cleared by the Food and Drug Administration.
